text:
ben: Heads up — want to lock the launch acceptance checklist for Optimize Toolkit (batching / caching / quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). Can we do a quick alignment? Key customer asks: clear SLO guidance, SDK toggles, per-tenant thresholds.

carla: Quick sketch of acceptance gates: p99 latency regression <= 10% vs baseline, median cost/unit improvement >= 12% for typical workloads, cache hit rate >= X for routes opted-in, and eval-alert false-positive rate <= 8%.

alice: Can we make the FP/thresholds configurable per-customer? Enterprise customers will want stricter FP controls and audit logs.

ben: Agreed. Plan: default recommended thresholds + per-tenant override via API + presets (low-risk / balanced / aggressive). We'll include audit events for every override.

derek: Ops concerns: console needs per-model & per-route panels showing avg latency, tokens/sec, cache hit rate, batch-size distribution, and a heatmap for eval alert hits. Need a clear rollback path if alerts spike after rollout.

eva: QA plan: synthetic load tests (short/long context patterns) + pilot with ~5 customers for 2 weeks. Smoke for correctness: compare quantized outputs vs float baseline on a held set and run concordance/delta checks. Also run fail-open tests for caching.

carla: For eval-triggered alerts I suggest this triage flow: alert -> auto-sample N outputs -> run concordance metric (e.g., p(concordant) or delta-accuracy) -> if concordance drop > 5% escalate to SEV and auto-disable the specific recommendation for that tenant. Keep human-in-loop for re-enable.

ben: :thumbsup: Add to checklist. SDK toggle idea: expose per-tenant and per-call flags, e.g.:

```json
// SDK example (pseudocode)
client.optimize.apply({
  tenant_id: "acme",
  presets: "balanced",
  overrides: { disable_recs: false, quantization_level: "q4_0" }
})
```

We should also offer a global admin API to flip recommendations for all routes in a tenant.

derek: Deploy plan (ops): staged rollout = internal alpha -> canary (5% traffic) -> pilot tenants -> GA. Canary monitors: error rate, concordance metric, cache-hit delta, batch-size anomalies. Automated rollback if error rate > 0.5% or concordance drop > 3% sustained 5m.

alice: Docs checklist: decision tree for preset selection, example cost vs latency charts, how to interpret eval-alerts, runbook for false positives and automatic remediation steps. Also include SDK snippets and admin API examples.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for optimize-toolkit v1.2 on cluster-prod-23 — monitoring hooks enabled.

ben: Owners: ben (PM) = acceptance criteria + pilot signoff; carla (ProdEng) = thresholds & infra hooks; derek (SRE) = metrics + rollback automation; eva (QA) = test harness + pilot validation; alice (DevEx) = SDK + docs. Next sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. TL;DR: lock checklist, run 2-week pilot, ensure per-tenant overrides & observability, staged rollout with automated rollback triggers.
